comment: The class of each tool of php-serialize that make rebuild-check checks (S1).

legacy/packages/js/index.js.reason: the product of this repository: the serialize format of PHP, ported from php-src so that every value reads and writes back exactly as PHP does

legacy/packages/python/src/polyspec/php_.reason: the product of this repository: the serialize format of PHP, ported from php-src so that every value reads and writes back exactly as PHP does

scripts/contracts.mts.reason: writes the contract from real PHP, the reference of the format, a rule of this repository

scripts/php-tree.mts.reason: the PHP that writes the typed tree which the contract and the fuzz compare, a rule of this repository

scripts/fuzz-temp.mts.reason: the directory of a fuzz run, which fuzz.mts needs for the inputs and outputs of real PHP and the ports, and the removal of what killed runs left, a rule of this repository

scripts/fuzz.mts.reason: compares the ports with real PHP on corrupted and generated input, the proof of this repository; it needs PHP as the oracle and the typed tree of the contract

scripts/bindgen.mts.reason: runs bindgen at the commit of polyspec-bindgen-core that Cargo.lock pins, from the checkout that Cargo made of it, because no registry holds the tool before its release (bindgen design L-2)
